headlines.summary: Netanyahu's right-wing bloc leads but is falling short of the votes needed to form a government.

headlines.summary: The Bucharest court has extended the pre-trial detention of Calin Georgescu by 30 days, appealing a lower court ruling.

headlines.title: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
headlines.summary: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, a crash in which one train struck another from behind, killing 68 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network.

headlines.title: Brewers beat the Rays to win the first World Series title in franchise history
headlines.summary: The small-ball Milwaukee Brewers playing in the smallest market in the majors are World Series champions for the first time. The championship comes in the 58th season for a franchise that began as the Seattle Pilots in 1969.

headlines.title: Hackers expose the identities of more than 40,000 DHS employees
headlines.summary: A group of hacktivists calling themselves Distributed Denial of Secrets, said the unmasking of ICE agents, DHS operatives and contractors was fair play, given the government's lack of transparency.

headlines.title: Forecasters are predicting a warmer and wetter winter. Here's how El Niño will affect your region
headlines.summary: El Niño years typically lead to more precipitation and higher-than-average temperatures. The latest data shows the different potential impacts by region.

headlines.title: Judge denies the Justice Department's bid to stop processing California ballots
headlines.summary: While the judge rejected the Department of Justice's unprecedented demand in California, the case isn't over yet. The federal government immediately filed notice that it will appeal.

headlines.title: Cost concerns set to shape US midterms
headlines.summary: The United States will vote on Tuesday in the 2026 midterm elections, a key test of public sentiment toward President Donald Trump and the Republican Party, with economic concerns high on voters' minds.

headlines.title: Macron puts money on the table to calm mass protests
headlines.summary: The French government has announced 1 billion euros ($1.1 billion) for university renovations and 4 billion euros in loans for local authorities to upgrade high schools, in a bid to defuse ongoing student protests across the country.

headlines.title: Lula calls Bolsonaro's departure 'shameful'
headlines.summary: RIO DE JANEIRO — Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on Tuesday criticized defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro for leaving the country following the election, calling the move "shameful".

headlines.title: Efforts to contain Ebola outbreak intensify as cases surpass 10,000
headlines.summary: Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and international partners are intensifying efforts to contain the current Ebola outbreak, as confirmed cases have surpassed 10,000.

headlines.title: Unity key to greater voice of Global South
headlines.summary: Global South nations should build on their unity and amplify their voice in multilateral mechanisms to better enjoy the dividends of evolving technologies and economic globalization, prominent political figures, scholars and media executives said on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Extremely harmful to Indian democracy: Rijiju slams Naseeruddin Shah's 'dimagi naxal' video
headlines.summary: Rijiju slams Naseeruddin Shah as a “dimagi naxal,” claiming his views harm Indian democracy amid campus protests and NEET criticisms.

headlines.title: MEA highlights stronger linkages between Japan and northeast India
headlines.summary: MEA says stronger Japan-Northeast India linkages will boost bilateral partnership and regional connectivity, with enhanced cooperation including language training and joint projects.

headlines.title: Poland pivots towards India as ‘strategic partnership’ with China develops cracks
headlines.summary: Poland shifts from China to India as a strategic partnership deepens, boosting trade and independence from Beijing amid EU-China tensions.
